profile.headline: Remote BackEnd Software Engineer at Aweber
profile.summary:
I am a Python Developer looking for career growth in backend development with Django. I’m familiar with Cloud Services (AWS and DigitalOcean), CI/CD pipelines, RESTful API's, PostgreSQL, and more. Im open to Hybrid/Remote positions around Philadelphia, PA

I am a Daring, Determined, Meticulous individual with a passion for developing new revolutionary products and technologies. I bring attention to detail and an unmatched passion to everything that I do.

I will create and challenge the innovations of technology for communities with barriers to improve the quality of life for future generations

I treat life like a PhD Program, constantly pulling knowledge from all areas of life and applying it to the path ahead.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Negotiated and expanded project scope through effective cross-team collaboration, taking ownership of designing and implementing the backend architecture for the migration of Eventbrite API integration from legacy polling to modern webhooks. Achieved this ambitious goal within a tight timeframe, significantly reducing latency, enhancing system reliability, and delivering real-time event updates, showcasing the ability to excel under pressure.
• Delivering and Maintaining internal and external facing RESTful services and consumers all the way to production using Tornado(an asynchronous python framework), Flask, and Pyramid
• Routinely working as the developer on call for production facing issues surrounding the integrations code-base
positions.insights: Skills: Tornado · Python (Programming Language) · Flask · Grafana · docker · Kubernetes · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Streamlined the CI/CD pipeline deployment process via resulting in a 98.6% time reduction
• Developed website using Sphinx Python framework to provide guidance to internal and external
customers on using the IQMotion API in C++, Python, Matlab, and Arduino
• Automated the deployment process from testing to production for IQ Control Center Application on
Linux, Mac, and Windows using Bash/Zsh scripting and Qt Deployment Tools
• Improved IQMotion’s Anticogging Algorithm by 13.4% by refactoring math equations and code
functionality in Python
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C++ · PostgreSQL · Shell Scripting · MATLAB · DigitalOcean · Qt

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
• Instructor and Mentor to 16-20 students helping develop resilience and grit alongside a strong coding foundation via Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Weekly lesson plan management, homework assignment, coaching, and review, while identifying development opportunities to support each student’s unique pace
• Working as an active ambassador for Juni Learning by openly recruiting more students and instructors towards the online learning platform

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
• Built and managed SuiteCRM using AWS in conjunctions with MySQL & PHP to house 200+ clientele information, automated lead generation, and automated daily business workflows
• Built propriety Search Engine using Selenium with Python to scrape property information across multiple websites (Zillow, County Websites, Redfin, Court Records, etc) in conjunction with Zillow APIs to join data into a lead generation process
• Facilitated over a dozen real estate transactions across a network of 100+ investors, agents, buyers, and sellers in the Pittsburgh Metro Area

positions.title: Professor
positions.description:
• Taught biweekly lectures focused on increasing the knowledge of HS students to self implement embedded and IOT concepts such as Request/Response handling, Authentication, REST APIs (such as OpenWeather and Twilio), and Databases.
• Created biweekly lab projects that provided students hands-on experience developing their own smart home devices using a Photon Particle Board with C++
• Provided and graded homework, offered office hours and assignment reviews, and managed lab sessions for approximately 24 students

positions.title: Assistant Researcher
positions.description:
• Lead tester for Indoor Positioning Systems using both the HTC Vive and the DWM1000 UWB Chips with geospatial software (using gaming software Unity & C++) to create augmented digitization tags 
• Utilized the UWB chip in conjunction with the ESP32 Embedded Chip (using C++) to compute position in 3D space by reverse engineering DWM app code and comparing to infrared laser triangulation and time of flight methods 
• Participated in collaboration sessions with key leaders and PhD Students on the early stages of the development cycle to determine possible applications

positions.title: Embedded Systems Research Intern
positions.description:
• Lead the research initiative to port hibernation restoration from Linux Kernel to the LK Bootloader (using C++) for a 30% faster boot to app space from a cold start
• Delivered report on 30% faster boot time to the Automotive team and the VP of engineering at the end of internship
• Collaborated with the automotive team to deliver faster boot times on a car’s electronics system 
• Maintained confidentiality on special projects working on new B2B operations in the automotive space.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
• Invented bluetooth smart speaker pillow using the C++ and the ARM Cortex-M4 in conjunction with the nRF52840 Bluetooth chip to address insomnia utilizing white/pink ambient noise
• Designed electrical system Schematic by hand, and used Eagle to design the PCB
• Considered for a $75k Grant from AlphaLab Gear which supports consumer technology startups

positions.title: QNoC Intern
positions.description:
• Responsible for creating an internal spreadsheet application capable of analyzing 100,000+ performance and data metrics as a Microsoft Excel replacement
• Utilized Qlikview graphics and Python scripting to manage computations and metric charts

positions.title: Embedded/Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Lead of Engineering for the electrical systems of the Safety Critical Car Seat in a fast paced startup environment
• Oversaw the product through most of the software development life cycle from analysis, design, implementation, up to formal testing
• Programmed in C++ using Atmel Studio IDE and the resource constrained ATTiny44a Atmel Chip to designed and implement the world’s first working open source I2C Driver for the chip
• Used Altium to redesign the PCB boards to include switches and actuators to enhance feedback for the safety critical Baby Car Seat as well as developed testing modules using Arduino’s to control motor drivers and sensors

positions.title: CoreBSP Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Created On-Chip C/C++ Debugger entitled ‘QDB’ for CoreBSP team that replaced licensed software debugger “Trace32”
• Decreased initial debugging process from 10-15 minutes to 62 seconds
• Mastered ELF and DWARF formatting for debugging purposes

projects.title: Embedded Real-Time Systems
projects.description:
• Built a custom Real-Time Resource Kernel on top of Linux for SMP systems
• Implemented scheduling and resource management schemes (RMS & Bin-Packing) to ensure
schedulability of tasks and utilization load of each CPU are sufficient

projects.title: RLColor
projects.description: Interacting with painters, I've learned that there's always a challenge of blending colors properly and recreating the same color multiple times. Having to do this by hand was a skill in itself that many artists have to take time to learn. This same time could be used to perfect their craft. That's why with the help of a team, we built a real life color picker (RLColorPicker). Our RLColorPicker could capture, digitize, recreate the color using CMYK paint. Our system was able to accurately capture the colors of real life objects as well as recreate those perfect color mixes that artists were only able to create, "once".
